reviewer: Codex; one qualitative reviewer, no independent blinded ratings
criteria: Meaning, roles, names, amounts, polarity and commands preserved.
No invented content, assistant preambles, placeholders or code fences in ordinary prose.
Equivalent grammatical paraphrases accepted; a single filler in Chat is allowed by its light-cleanup prompt.
limitations: Only 28 handcrafted tasks; not a published grammar leaderboard.
All second-repetition delivered outputs matched the first, so quality is scored once per task.
One-task differences should not establish universal quality superiority.
